purpose: Teach: セキュリティー/書き込む/宝くじ/猛烈/若しくは/つかみ/近々/なんだかんだ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが家のセキュリティーを真剣にお考えだった
lines.en: When you were young, your father was very serious about keeping the house secure.
lines.style: Soft, reflective opening. Measured pace. Gentle nostalgia — looking backward through time. Quiet warmth underneath the wistfulness. Slight pause before 'secure' as if remembering the detail.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、日記に毎日書き込むのを欠かさなかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — he never missed writing in his diary, did he? Not once.
lines.style: Bright recognition. Affectionate correction wrapped in tenderness. Warm and present, speaking directly to him. Gentle emphasis on 'never missed,' like she's marveling at the memory with him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが宝くじを楽しみに買われた
lines.en: When you were young, your father loved buying lottery tickets.
lines.style: Softer now, almost wry. Wistful but lighter — a small human habit, not a grand one. Even pacing. Slight smile in the voice, the kind that comes from remembering something both small and dear.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、夏の猛烈な暑さにも負けなかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Even on those brutal summer days, he never let the heat slow him down, did he?
lines.style: Warm admiration in the voice. Upward lilt on 'did he?' — checking in with him, not lecturing. Gentle amazement at the memory. Affectionate and present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが酒若しくはお茶を毎晩嗜まれた
lines.en: When you were young, your father would have sake or tea every evening without fail.
lines.style: Quieter, more intimate. Wistful and tender at once. A small, ordinary ritual spoken as if it held something precious. Gentle pace. Trailing off slightly, letting the image sit.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様の手をしっかりつかみ歩かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he'd walk with your grandchildren, holding their hands so tight. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Tender and present. Direct address to him. Warm emphasis on 'so tight' — capturing the fierceness of that grip with affection. Slightly longer pause before the question, letting it settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、近々、孫が結婚するそうだ
lines.en: Soon, one of the grandchildren will be getting married.
lines.style: Quieter shift. Wistful and present at once. The weight of time and continuation. Measured pace. Slight pause before 'getting married' — marking the moment. Tender underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、なんだかんだで人生を楽しまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: But whatever happened, you lived life well, didn't you? Really well.
lines.style: Warm, intimate closer. Soft voice, face near. Gentle emphasis on 'well' — not praising, affirming. A love letter in a question. Close, present, affirming.
